ceip-polder-land-payments-bangladesh.whole: By the Bank's own count the project upgraded 405.67 km of embankment across 10 polders, against a revised target of 408 km and an original target of 623 km, and upgraded 305.85 km of drainage channels, built 89 drainage structures and 85 flushing structures and planted 700 hectares of trees. It protected 65,657 hectares and gave 720,573 people more protection from storm surges and salt water, close to the revised targets of 66,012 hectares and 724,202 people but short of the original target of 100,800 hectares. The completion report of 28 June 2024 puts the economic rate of return for the whole project at 25.7 per cent at closing, rates efficiency Modest and rates the overall outcome Moderately Satisfactory; the Independent Evaluation Group's review of 30 November 2024 also rates the outcome Moderately Satisfactory. Every figure is the lender's, reporting on its own project, and no independent check was found.

lahore-walled-city-shop-removals.whole: The loan paid for 14 infrastructure investments across town administrations in Punjab as well as the Walled City works. By the Bank's own count households with piped connections to clean drinking water in the 11 towns with water sub-projects rose from 40 per cent to 53 per cent, against a target of 59 per cent, and the share of solid waste taken to sanitary landfills in six towns rose from none to 74 per cent. Rates of return were recalculated after closing for only four sub-projects: 13 per cent and 5 per cent for the two water sub-projects and 14.9 per cent and 15 per cent for the two road sub-projects, against a 12 per cent discount rate. The completion report of 19 May 2014 rates the outcome Satisfactory; the Independent Evaluation Group's review of 2 June 2015 rates it Moderately Satisfactory and rates efficiency modest. Both accounts are the lender's own, and no independent check was found.

nepal-road-sector-unpaid-compensation.whole: By the Bank's own count 680 km of dry-season roads and tracks were upgraded to all-season standard, against a revised target of 705 km, and 1,500 m of major and 9,000 m of minor bridge maintenance were completed. The share of people in the project districts within reach of an all-season road rose from 8 per cent in 2007 to 15 per cent, against a target of 14 per cent, and the journey to markets and district headquarters fell from four hours to 1.9 hours. The Independent Evaluation Group's review of 22 February 2021 records 752,000 people benefiting against a target of 800,000. Rates of return at completion were 41.1 per cent on the original roads and 29.4 per cent on the first additional financing; the completion report of 30 September 2020 and the review both rate the outcome Moderately Satisfactory, and the review rates efficiency modest. These are the lender's own figures and no independent check was found.

swat-s3b-road-land-acquisition.whole: By the Bank's own count 50.3 km of road was built, against a revised target of 40.9 km, the extra length paid for out of savings. Vehicle operating costs fell 34 per cent for two-axle trucks, 26 per cent for three-axle trucks and 5 per cent for passenger buses. The rates of return of 29.9 per cent for the first phase and 28.0 per cent for the second and third were estimates made at appraisal; the Independent Evaluation Group's review of 28 February 2017 records that no rate of return was estimated at completion and rates efficiency modest. The completion report of 11 August 2016 and the review both rate the outcome Moderately Satisfactory. All the figures come from the Bank reporting on its own grant, and no independent check was found.

siddhirganj-pipeline-transmission-land.whole: The project built a 335 MW combined-cycle power station, which tested at a net output of 345 MW, a 60 km gas transmission pipeline and an 11 km 230 kV double-circuit transmission line with two substations. In its first ten months of commercial operation the station sent 935 GWh to the grid at about 38 per cent utilisation, against a target of 2,490 GWh a year; the completion report attributes the low use to dispatch practices and to lower demand during the pandemic, and records the station's cost at BDT 1.03 to 1.06 per kWh, sixth to ninth cheapest of 45 baseload plants on the dispatch list. The rate of return was 26.33 per cent at completion and 31 per cent when estimated at the 2014 restructuring. The completion report of 28 September 2020 rates the overall outcome Moderately Satisfactory. No Independent Evaluation Group review and no independent check of these figures were found; the lender is the only source.

gujarat-highway-ii-delayed-compensation.whole: The Independent Evaluation Group's review of 13 June 2022 records 423 km of state highway built, against a target of 460.7 km, and 292.80 km rehabilitated as targeted, 715.80 km in all. Car journey times on project roads fell from 75 to 57 minutes per 50 km, against a target of 50 minutes, and truck journeys from 85 to 67 minutes against a target of 65; average road surface roughness was 1,758 mm per km, inside the 2,000 mm standard. The rate of return calculated after closing was 51.9 per cent, against 35.1 per cent at appraisal, while the net present value was Rs 20.2 billion after closing against Rs 21.3 billion at appraisal; the review cites the completion report's explanation that costs came in lower and that the road length measured was 25 km shorter. The review rates the outcome Moderately Satisfactory. The completion report itself is not disclosed, so these figures exist only as the review's summary of it, and no independent check was found.

dehlon-bypass-uncompensated-landowner.whole: The Independent Evaluation Group's review of 8 May 2018 records 711 km of road upgraded, rehabilitated or maintained, against an original target of 700 km, 347 accident black spots improved, and the Dehlon bypass completed. Average speed on the state's Plan Road network rose from 34.2 km an hour in 2006 to 47.6 km an hour in 2017, close to the revised target of 48. Fatal accidents on that network rose from 2,655 in 2005 to 5,077 in 2016, then fell about 15 per cent to about 4,278 in 2017. Rates of return recalculated after the works were 31.8 per cent for upgrading, 28.5 per cent for rehabilitation and 50.4 per cent for periodic maintenance, against appraisal estimates of 36.5, 44.2 and 58.4 per cent; the review cites the completion report's explanation that capital costs rose, works were delayed and traffic grew more slowly than forecast. The review rates the outcome Moderately Unsatisfactory. The completion report is not disclosed, the figures are the lender's own, and no independent check was found.

salem-tnudp-squatter-resettlement.whole: By the Bank's own count the sub-projects commissioned under the loan brought improved water and sewerage services to more than 2.3 million people, including 440,000 in low-income neighbourhoods, and built 290,000 new household sewer connections against a target of 150,000. Tamil Nadu raised US$52 million for urban infrastructure from bonds, public-private deals and household contributions, against a target of US$40 million. The weighted average rate of return across the sub-projects was 19 per cent, highest for water supply at 24 per cent and lowest for roads at 15 per cent. The completion report rates the outcome Satisfactory; the Independent Evaluation Group's review rates it Moderately Satisfactory and rates efficiency modest. All the figures are the lender's own and no independent check was found.

assam-roads-uncompensated-acquisition.whole: By the Bank's own count about 978 km of Assam's secondary road network was upgraded or rehabilitated against a revised target of 1,000 km, made up of about 248 km of widening and upgrading and about 730 km of pavement rehabilitation and strengthening. Average travel time fell 23 per cent on the upgraded roads and 27 per cent on the rehabilitated ones, against a target of 20 per cent. Rates of return at completion were 41.14 per cent for the upgrading roads and 25.79 per cent for the rehabilitation roads, against appraisal estimates of 45 per cent and 37.4 per cent. The completion report of 25 March 2020 rates efficiency Modest and the overall outcome Moderately Satisfactory; the Independent Evaluation Group's review of 26 June 2020 rates efficiency substantial and the outcome Satisfactory. Both are the lender reporting on its own project and no independent check was found.

drc-selembao-loange-compensation.whole: By the Bank's own count water production in the project areas rose from 160,000 to 330,000 cubic metres a day and the number of people with access to piped water from 1.6 million to 4.0 million, against a target of 4.0 million. Electricity in the target areas went from three hours a day to 24 hours a day. On roads the project maintained 1,047 km against a target of 1,339 km and rehabilitated 2,123 km of feeder roads against a target of 2,500 km. The Independent Evaluation Group's review records that no economic or financial analysis was carried out either before or after the project, rates efficiency modest and rates the outcome Moderately Satisfactory; the completion report of 29 October 2010 rates the outcome Satisfactory. The figures are the lender's own and no independent check was found.

ghana-urban-water-unpaid-compensation.whole: By the Bank's own count the project gave 850,300 people in Ghana's towns access to improved water supply, against an original target of 500,000, through 45,000 new piped household connections, 90 per cent of the 50,000 targeted, and 449 community water points, 90 per cent of the 500 targeted. Work covered 25 water supply systems across 10 regions, of which 21 were finished or about 95 per cent finished when the credit closed. At the end of the project a cubic metre of water from a utility connection cost 3.6 Ghana cedis, against 13.88 cedis from vendor-managed standpipes and 11.10 cedis from boreholes. The rate of return was 26.18 per cent at completion; the appraisal figure of 21 per cent was calculated, the completion report says, over a different timeframe and at a different exchange rate. Both the completion report of 21 December 2016 and the Independent Evaluation Group's review of 15 June 2017 rate the outcome Moderately Unsatisfactory. All the figures are the lender's own and no independent check was found.

burkina-donsin-airport-roads-resettlemen.whole: The Independent Evaluation Group's review records the 24.3 km two-lane link road built as planned, 17.2 km of national road NR3 rehabilitated against a target of 17.5 km, and 42.5 km of rural roads improved against a target of 40 km. The drive from the village of Donsin to the Kossodo traffic circle in Ouagadougou fell from 50 minutes to 25 minutes, meeting the target, and from Loumbila from 23 minutes to 15 minutes against a target of 14. The rate of return was 15.3 per cent after the works, against 14.3 per cent estimated beforehand by the airport project body. The review rates the outcome Moderately Unsatisfactory, and the new airport the roads were built to serve had no private operator selected when the credit closed. The completion report is not disclosed; every figure comes from the Bank reporting on its own project and no independent check was found.

rwanda-rssp2-marshland-resettlement.whole: Rice production in the marshlands rehabilitated under the project rose from 5,597 tonnes to 18,675 tonnes, against a target of 11,194 tonnes, and rice yields rose from 3 tonnes a hectare to 6.7 tonnes a hectare for the farmers taking part. Nine marshland sites were developed, with eight dams built at five of them, and a further 10,096 hectares of hillside were protected against erosion, bringing the total to 24,581 hectares. The completion report puts the economic rate of return at 47 per cent against 34 per cent at appraisal, and rates the overall outcome Highly Satisfactory. All of these figures come from the World Bank and the project's own staff reporting on their own work; no Independent Evaluation Group review and no independent check were found.

south-west-roads-turkestan-sairam-compen.whole: By the Bank's own count the project built 1,281 km of highway along the Western Europe-Western China corridor, most of it widened to four-lane dual carriageway, and speed limits on many sections rose from 60 to 110 km an hour up to 140 km an hour. The state road company KazAvtoZhol reported vehicle operating costs down 35 per cent to US$0.17 per vehicle-kilometre, better than the target of US$0.23; that figure is the road company's own, and the completion report says its own separate modelling supports it. A road user survey commissioned by the World Bank in 2017 found satisfaction with road quality at 85 per cent after construction against 7 per cent before, and average travel time to work down from 123 minutes to 79 minutes. The average rate of return after completion was 15.6 per cent, against 13 per cent at appraisal. The completion report of 19 June 2025 and the Independent Evaluation Group's review of it both rate the outcome Satisfactory. No independent check of the output figures was found.

hanoi-ring-road-2-relocation.whole: By the Bank's own count the project built 6.1 km of Ring Road 2 through the north-west of Hanoi, with interchanges at Buoi, Dao Tan and Cau Giay, overpasses, lighting and traffic signals, and the road opened on 18 January 2016. A traffic count for the completion report found 77,000 to 93,000 vehicles on the road on a typical weekday between 7 a.m. and 7 p.m., half to three-quarters of them motorcycles, and five more bus routes were able to run. Bus journey time from Cau Giay to the dyke road at Nhat Tan fell from 28 to 21 minutes against a target of 20, and the motorcycle journey the other way took 11 minutes against a target of 18. The ring road component's rate of return was 18.5 per cent at completion against 14.5 per cent at appraisal, while the bus rapid transit component's was 6.0 per cent at completion against 21.0 per cent at appraisal. The completion report of 31 January 2018 and the Independent Evaluation Group's review of it both rate the outcome Moderately Satisfactory. The figures are the lender's own and no independent check was found.

bahia-viver-melhor-ii-resettlement.whole: By the Bank's own count the share of households in the project areas within 250 metres of a paved road rose from 92.5 per cent to 100 per cent, the share with access to a sanitation network from 74.78 per cent to 89.7 per cent, and the share within a kilometre of a park, plaza, sports field or community centre from none to 33 per cent. Against those figures, 1,093 households received the urban infrastructure works counted under the project's own output indicator, against a target of 6,332, which the completion report attributes to unfinished works in four areas; 14,080 people took part in the project's social activities against a target of 12,812, and 904 attended vocational training against a target of 600. The Independent Evaluation Group's review of 26 June 2014 puts the rate of return at 16 per cent after the project against 33.9 to 37.6 per cent across the three sites at appraisal, states that the completion report used a different method from the appraisal because price data were missing, and records the cost of each housing unit at US$11,482 against an average of US$3,000 per household in a 2005 United Nations study of slum upgrading. Both the completion report and the review rate the outcome Moderately Unsatisfactory. All the figures are the lender's own and no independent check was found.

rurrenabaque-airport-land-compensation.whole: By the Bank's own count the project built 22 bridges on the San Buenaventura-Ixiamas road, 21 of them new, and paved 7 km of the roughly 114 km route, with the rest kept passable by maintenance. The road had been impassable 75 days a year before the works and had no days of interruption between April 2023 and the completion report; car journey times fell from about three hours to under two in the dry season and from more than five hours to about two in the wet season, and bus fares from San Buenaventura to Ixiamas fell from 50 to 30 bolivianos. At Rurrenabaque airport the share of scheduled flights actually operated rose from 65 per cent to 95 per cent against a target of 90 per cent, with 4,912 passengers in 2022 and 10,120 in 2023; the completion report states that earlier works paid for by the Beni prefecture and the national airport agency also contributed and that the gains cannot be attributed to the project alone. The road's net present value at completion was US$0.5 million with a rate of return of 13.0 per cent, against US$25.7 million and 15.5 per cent at appraisal, the completion report attributing the fall to lower traffic and a changed vehicle mix. The completion report of 31 May 2024 rates the outcome Moderately Satisfactory and the Independent Evaluation Group's review of it rates it Moderately Unsatisfactory. All the figures are the lender's own and no independent check was found.

philippines-nrimp2-unpaid-land-claims.whole: By the Bank's own count 295 km of national road was upgraded to paved standard against a revised target of 280 km and an original target of 450 km, 680 km was maintained under long-term performance-based contracts, meeting that target, and 1,200 km of non-rural roads were rehabilitated against a target of 1,500 km. The share of projects delivered within 15 per cent of their original cost and time rose from 6 per cent to 50 per cent against a target of 70 per cent, and 74 per cent of outside stakeholders said they were satisfied with the national road system against a target above 60 per cent. The two Bank documents differ on road condition: the completion report's results table gives the share of national roads in good or fair condition at completion as 55 per cent, unchanged from the baseline and short of the revised target of 60 per cent, while the Independent Evaluation Group's review gives 77 per cent, a figure it attributes to what the Bank's project team told the evaluators rather than to a document. Rates of return recalculated at closing averaged 23.4 per cent across the sub-projects examined, ranging from 11.5 to 35.3 per cent, against 27 per cent for the same sub-projects at appraisal. Both documents rate the outcome Moderately Satisfactory. All the figures are the lender's own and no independent check was found.
